answer: Neighbor-quorum bond stops mass fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credits and gathers seven neighbor signatures in the canyon registry, each a jade seal. A reef beacon calls one in ten identities each epoch; silence from any signer burns the bond. Each neighbor signs at most three, so 1,000 fakes need 2,334 neighbors and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented signers sharing keys burn. Honest agents pay 70 once and keep their share.
